# Game Idea: Neon Escape

A minimalist HTML canvas game where the player controls a glowing square that continuously moves forward on a vertically scrolling field of colored bars. Use arrow keys to dodge the bars; collect occasional shields for temporary invincibility. The game speeds up over time. **Lose condition:** colliding with any bar or moving off‑screen.

1: // Neon Escape game with enhanced graphics
2: // Assumes an existing <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Sound effects
9:   const collisionSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YRAAAAAA');
10:   const shieldSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YRAAAAAA');
11:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400;
12:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
13: 
14:   // Player (glowing square)
15:   const player = {
16:     size: 30,
17:     x: WIDTH / 2 - 15,
18:     y: HEIGHT - 60,
19:     speed: 4,
20:     invincible: false,
21:     invincibilityTimer: 0,
22:       draw() {
23:         // Neon glow effect
24:         ctx.save();
25:         ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
26:         ctx.shadowColor = this.invincible ? 'rgba(255,255,0,0.8)' : 'rgba(0,255,255,0.8)';
27:         ctx.fillStyle = this.invincible ? 'rgba(255,255,0,0.9)' : '#0ff';
28:         ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.size, this.size);
29:         ctx.restore();
30:       },
31:     update() {
32:       if (keys['ArrowLeft']) this.x -= this.speed;
33:       if (keys['ArrowRight']) this.x += this.speed;
34:       if (keys['ArrowUp']) this.y -= this.speed;
35:       if (keys['ArrowDown']) this.y += this.speed;
36:       // Keep inside canvas
37:       this.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(WIDTH - this.size, this.x));
38:       this.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(HEIGHT - this.size, this.y));
39:       // Invincibility countdown
40:       if (this.invincibilityTimer > 0) {
41:         this.invincibilityTimer -= delta;
42:         if (this.invincibilityTimer <= 0) this.invincible = false;
43:       }
44:     }
45:   };
46: 
47:   // Obstacles (colored bars)
48:   const bars = [];
49:   const barHeight = 20;
50:   let speed = 2; // scrolling speed, increases over time
51:   let spawnTimer = 0;
52:   const spawnInterval = 1200; // ms
53: 
54:   // Power‑ups (shields)
55:   const shields = [];
56:   const shieldSize = 20;
57: 
58:   const keys = {};
59:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
60:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
61: 
62:   let lastTime = performance.now();
63:   let delta = 0;
64:   let gameOver = false;
65: 
66:   function spawnBar() {
67:     const bar = {
68:       x: 0,
69:       y: -barHeight,
70:       width: Math.random() * (WIDTH * 0.6) + WIDTH * 0.2,
71:       height: barHeight,
72:       color: `hsl(${Math.random() * 360}, 70%, 50%)`
73:     };
74:     // random horizontal offset
75:     bar.x = Math.random() * (WIDTH - bar.width);
76:     bars.push(bar);
77:   }
78: 
79:   function spawnShield() {
80:     const shield = {
81:       x: Math.random() * (WIDTH - shieldSize),
82:       y: -shieldSize,
83:       size: shieldSize,
84:     };
85:     shields.push(shield);
86:   }
87: 
88:   function rectIntersect(ax, ay, aw, ah, bx, by, bw, bh) {
89:     return ax < bx + bw && ax + aw > bx && ay < by + bh && ay + ah > by;
90:   }
91: 
92:   function update(dt) {
93:     if (gameOver) return;
94:     delta = dt / 1000; // seconds
95:     player.update();
96: 
97:     // move bars
98:     for (let i = bars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
99:       const b = bars[i];
100:       b.y += speed;
101:       if (b.y > HEIGHT) bars.splice(i, 1);
102: else if (!player.invincible && rectIntersect(player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size, b.x, b.y, b.width, b.height)) {
103:           collisionSound.currentTime = 0;
104:           collisionSound.play();
105:           gameOver = true;
106:         }
107:     }
108: 
109:     // move shields
110:     for (let i = shields.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
111:       const s = shields[i];
112:       s.y += speed;
113:       if (s.y > HEIGHT) shields.splice(i, 1);
114: else if (rectIntersect(player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size, s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size)) {
115:           shieldSound.currentTime = 0;
116:           shieldSound.play();
117:           player.invincible = true;
118:           player.invincibilityTimer = 3; // seconds
119:           shields.splice(i, 1);
120:         }
121:     }
122: 
123:     // spawn logic
124:     spawnTimer += dt;
125:     if (spawnTimer > spawnInterval) {
126:       spawnTimer = 0;
127:       spawnBar();
128:       // occasional shield (20% chance)
129:       if (Math.random() < 0.2) spawnShield();
130:     }
131: 
132:     // gradually increase speed
133:     speed += dt * 0.00002; // ~0.02 per second
134:   }
135: 
136:   function draw() {
137:     // dark neon background gradient
138:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
139:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
140:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
141:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
142:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
143: 
144:     // helper for rounded rectangle
145:     function roundedRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
146:       ctx.beginPath();
147:       ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
148:       ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
149:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
150:       ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
151:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
152:       ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
153:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
154:       ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
155:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
156:       ctx.closePath();
157:     }
158: 
159:     // draw bars with neon glow and rounded corners
160:     for (const b of bars) {
161:       ctx.save();
162:       ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
163:       ctx.shadowColor = b.color;
164:       ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
165:       roundedRect(b.x, b.y, b.width, b.height, 6);
166:       ctx.restore();
167:     }
168: 
169:     // draw shields with pulsating glow
170:     const time = performance.now() / 1000;
171:     for (const s of shields) {
172:       const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 5 + s.x);
173:       ctx.save();
174:       ctx.shadowBlur = 20 * pulse;
175:       ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,0,0.9)';
176:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,0,${0.6 + 0.4 * pulse})`;
177:       ctx.beginPath();
178:       ctx.arc(s.x + s.size / 2, s.y + s.size / 2, s.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
179:       ctx.fill();
180:       ctx.restore();
181:     }
182: 
183:     // draw player (already has glow)
184:     player.draw();
185: 
186:     if (gameOver) {
187:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
188:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
189:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
190:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
191:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
192:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2);
193:     }
194:   }
195: 
196:   function loop(timestamp) {
197:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
198:     lastTime = timestamp;
199:     update(dt);
200:     draw();
201:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
202:   }
203: 
204:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
205: })();

(End of file - total 205 lines)
</content>
